reviews.title: Space saving hamper - stores flat
reviews.review_text: This dark blue / navy blue laundry hamper holds a fair amount of clothing or other laundry - its about 21 inches tall and 16 to 17 inches measured across (diameter I think). Those are my measurements, not whats in the description or on the package. It has a spiral ring type device that encircles the basket that keeps it upright and gives it a tubular shape when opened, and actually has a fairly good amount of tension in it, meaning that the basket is going to stay upright and not collapse down accidentally. There is also an attached cover, or lid, that can be zipped closed. It doesn't remove completely, thus no worries about it being lost. A strap is attached on each side of the top to make for easy carrying if its full. And when its empty, it collapses almost completely flat so it takes very little storage space. Great idea this was! So far I've used it twice, meaning I've filled it up and emptied into the washer twice. It seems like it will hold up well although I haven't had it long enough to know its long term durability. For now giving it 5 stars because I have no issues with it and its very functional in its design and usefulness. Russell in Scottsdale
It's sturdy enough but much smaller than I thought it would be.
